claim: An agent-based model extends earlier 'strain theory' by addressing the var gene family of Plasmodium falciparum.
source_text: An agent-based model is developed that extends earlier 'strain theory' by addressing the var gene family of Plasmodium falciparum.
evidence_reasoning: The manuscript describes the development and implementation of a computational model, which constitutes data generated by the authors.

claim: Even under high levels of sexual recombination, strain competition mediated through cross-immunity structures the parasite population into a subset of coexisting dominant repertoires of var genes.
source_text: shows that even under high levels of sexual recombination, strain competition mediated through cross-immunity structures the parasite population into a subset of coexisting dominant repertoires of var genes
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the agent-based model simulations presented in the manuscript.

claim: The degree of antigenic overlap between dominant var gene repertoires depends on transmission intensity.
source_text: strain competition mediated through cross-immunity structures the parasite population into a subset of coexisting dominant repertoires of var genes whose degree of antigenic overlap depends on transmission intensity
evidence_reasoning: This relationship is demonstrated through model simulations shown in Figures 2 and 3.

claim: Empirical comparison of patterns of genetic variation at antigenic and neutral sites supports the role for immune selection in structuring parasite diversity.
source_text: Empirical comparison of patterns of genetic variation at antigenic and neutral sites supports this role for immune selection in structuring parasite diversity.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on analysis of empirical data from Papua New Guinea comparing var DBLα and microsatellite variation.

claim: Sufficient out-crossing should lead to random associations between alleles and preclude the persistence of independently transmitted strains.
source_text: while it would seem that sufficient out-crossing should always lead to random associations between alleles (Tibayrenc et al., 1990; Tibayrenc and Ayala, 2002) and preclude the persistence of 'independently transmitted strains' (Tibayrenc, 1994)
evidence_reasoning: This claim is attributed to prior work by Tibayrenc and colleagues.

claim: Mathematical models have demonstrated that immune selection can lead to the maintenance of discrete, non-overlapping, antigenic repertoires even when antigenic variability is driven by several unlinked genes that undergo recombination.
source_text: mathematical models of competition between pathogen strains have demonstrated that immune selection can lead to the maintenance of discrete, non-overlapping, antigenic repertoires—even when antigenic variability is driven by several unlinked genes that undergo recombination
evidence_reasoning: This refers to findings from previous mathematical modeling studies cited in the text.

claim: P. falciparum is responsible for the deadliest type of malaria in humans.
source_text: P. falciparum is responsible for the deadliest type of malaria in humans.
evidence_reasoning: This is established scientific knowledge about malaria pathology.

claim: Var genes encode P. falciparum erythrocyte membrane protein 1 (PfEMP1), the major surface antigen of the parasite's blood stages.
source_text: The var genes encode P. falciparum erythrocyte membrane protein 1 (PfEMP1)—the major surface antigen of the parasite's blood stages
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about var gene function, supported by citations to Miller et al., 2002 and Scherf et al., 2008.

claim: PfEMP1 binds to host endothelial cell receptors to allow the parasite to sequester within various host tissues.
source_text: the major surface antigen of the parasite's blood stages that binds to host endothelial cell receptors to allow the parasite to sequester within various host tissues
evidence_reasoning: This describes the established function of PfEMP1, supported by citations.

claim: DBLα is the only domain found in nearly all var genes.
source_text: DBLα, is the only domain found in nearly all var genes
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about var gene structure, cited to Miller et al., 2002.

claim: DBLα is the most informative molecular marker of var gene diversity.
source_text: DBLα, is the only domain found in nearly all var genes (Miller et al., 2002), and hence is the most informative molecular marker of var gene diversity.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the fact that DBLα is present in nearly all var genes, making it suitable for diversity studies.

claim: Each parasite genome has up to 60 var genes.
source_text: Each parasite genome has up to 60 var genes
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about P. falciparum genome organization.

claim: Differential sequential expression of var genes allows the parasite to evade the host immune response and establish a chronic infection.
source_text: differential sequential expression of these genes allows the parasite to evade the host immune response and establish a chronic infection
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about var gene function in immune evasion.

claim: Clonal antigenic variation extends the duration of infection to facilitate transmission to the mosquito.
source_text: This clonal antigenic variation sensu stricto (Miller et al., 2002; Scherf et al., 2008) extends the duration of infection to facilitate transmission to the mosquito.
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about the evolutionary function of antigenic variation, supported by citations.

claim: Specific var genes are associated with severe malarial disease and specific PfEMP1 binding phenotypes.
source_text: Not only do var genes influence transmission, but specific var genes are associated with severe malarial disease and specific PfEMP1 binding phenotypes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by multiple citations to recent studies (Deitsch et al., 2009; Chan et al., 2012; Claessens et al., 2012; Lavstsen et al., 2012; Warimwe et al., 2012).

claim: Individual P. falciparum genomes have distinct repertoires of var genes.
source_text: Population studies have shown that individual P. falciparum genomes have distinct repertoires of var genes
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to Barry et al., 2007; Scherf et al., 2008; Chen et al., 2011.

claim: Var genes extensively recombine during sexual recombination in the mosquito.
source_text: that extensively recombine (Freitas-Junior et al., 2000; Taylor et al., 2000) during sexual recombination in the mosquito (Paul et al., 1995)
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to studies demonstrating var gene recombination.

claim: The immense sequence diversity observed among var genes and var repertoires has been attributed to high rates of meiotic and possibly mitotic recombination.
source_text: The immense sequence diversity observed among var genes and var repertoires has been attributed to high rates of meiotic (and possibly also mitotic) recombination.
evidence_reasoning: This is an inference from observed diversity patterns, supported by knowledge of recombination mechanisms.

claim: High rates of recombination allow for very low linkage disequilibrium among var loci.
source_text: These high rates of recombination presumably allow for very low linkage disequilibrium among var loci.
evidence_reasoning: This is a logical inference from the relationship between recombination rate and linkage disequilibrium.

claim: The parasite population structure exhibits punctuated turnover with brief episodes of restructuring resulting in a new set of dominant var repertoires.
source_text: We find that the parasite population structure exhibits punctuated turnover: brief episodes of restructuring result in a new set of dominant var repertoires.
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the model simulations shown in Figure 1.

claim: Despite changing identities of dominant var repertoires, the overall diversity of repertoires present and individual gene frequencies remain remarkably constant.
source_text: Despite the changing identities of the dominant var repertoires, the overall diversity of repertoires present and the individual gene frequencies remain remarkably constant
evidence_reasoning: This observation is demonstrated in Figure 1 of the model results.

claim: Episodes of restructuring become more frequent as recombination rates increase, but the diversity of dominant var repertoires remains low throughout semi-stable states.
source_text: The episodes of restructuring become more frequent as recombination rates increase, but the diversity of dominant var repertoires remains low throughout these semi-stable states.
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated by comparing different recombination rates in Figure 1.

claim: The maintenance of population structure is robust even under very high levels of recombination.
source_text: Indeed, the maintenance of structure is found to be robust even under very high levels of recombination (Figure 1).
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated in the model simulations shown in Figure 1.

claim: The emergence of pathogen population structure is robust to alternative formulations that do not consider sequential expression or that consider randomly ordered sequential expression.
source_text: The emergence of pathogen population structure is robust to alternative formulations of our multi-locus model that do not consider sequential expression, or formulations that consider randomly ordered sequential expression.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on additional model simulations testing alternative assumptions.

claim: The level of diversity remains orders of magnitude lower than that potentially allowed by the gene pool.
source_text: The level of diversity remains orders of magnitude lower than that potentially allowed by the gene pool
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the model simulations comparing observed to potential diversity.

claim: Low transmission intensities are characterized by a low number of dominating genomes with a low level of antigenic overlap.
source_text: Emerging populations are typically characterized for low transmission intensities (A), by a low number of dominating genomes with a low level of antigenic overlap
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated in Figure 2A of the model results.

claim: High transmission intensities are characterized by higher diversity and higher antigenic similarity.
source_text: for high transmission intensities (B), by higher diversity and higher antigenic similarity
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated in Figure 2B of the model results.

claim: As transmission intensity increases, the number of dominating genomes increases.
source_text: As transmission intensity increases, the number of dominating genomes increases
evidence_reasoning: This relationship is shown in Figure 3A.

claim: As transmission intensity increases, the degree of antigenic similarity increases.
source_text: As transmission intensity increases, the number of dominating genomes increases, and in accordance, the degree of antigenic similarity increases as well
evidence_reasoning: This relationship is shown in Figure 3B.

claim: The number of distinct repertoires maintained in the system at epidemiologically relevant frequencies remains extremely low relative to the total number of distinct repertoires that can be created through recombination.
source_text: however the number of distinct repertoires that are maintained in the system at epidemiologically relevant frequencies remains extremely low relative to the total number of distinct repertoires that can be crated through recombination
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated in Figure 3 comparing observed to potential diversity.

claim: Under high-transmission regimes, high levels of superinfection and high parasite rates are observed in very young age classes, after which immunity is rapidly gained to most antigenic variants.
source_text: Under high-transmission regimes, we characteristically observe high levels of superinfection (i.e., relatively long durations of infection) and high parasite rates in the very young age classes, after which immunity is rapidly gained to most of the antigenic variants circulating in the population.
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated in Figure 4 showing age-structured immunity patterns.

claim: Host populations in regimes of very low transmission exhibit similar levels of parasite rates in all age groups, with immunity gradually gained throughout life.
source_text: In contrast, host populations in regimes of very low transmission, characteristically exhibit similar levels of parasite rates in all age groups, and immunity is gradually gained throughout life, with infection spanning all age classes.
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated in Figure 4 showing age-structured immunity patterns under low transmission.

claim: Immunity to strains with unique antigenic profiles is strain-specific and only gained through exposure to that particular strain.
source_text: Immunity to strain 1 is strain specific and only gained through exposure to this particular strain due to the uniqueness of its antigenic profile.
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated in Figure 5 and follows logically from the model structure.

claim: Immunity to strains that share genes with other strains is strain-transcending and acquired also by exposure to other strains.
source_text: By contrast, immunity to strain 2 is strain 'transcending' and acquired also by exposure to other strains with which it shares genes.
evidence_reasoning: This is demonstrated in Figure 5 and follows logically from the model structure.

claim: The frequency distribution of var types in Papua New Guinea isolates shows enrichment for both very rare and very common var types compared to the null expectation.
source_text: The observed distribution for the data (red) and the expected distribution when assuming all var types circulate at equal frequencies (blue) were found to be significantly different (pv<0.0001 using a K–S two sample test). Note the enrichment for both very rare and very common var types in the data.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on statistical analysis of empirical data from Papua New Guinea shown in Figure 6B.

claim: The co-occurrence of var types found in multiple isolates is significantly higher than the null expectation under linkage equilibrium.
source_text: The co-occurrence of var types found in multiple isolates is significantly higher than for the null expectation under the assumption of linkage equilibrium among all var types (pv<0.01)
evidence_reasoning: This is based on statistical analysis of empirical data shown in Figure 6C.

claim: Var DBLα repertoire relatedness is not a function of microsatellite repertoire relatedness.
source_text: The absence of any correlation suggests the possibility that var DBLα variation is shaped by other forces than the neutral demographic forces shaping microsatellite variation.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on analysis shown in Figure 6E and the inference drawn from the lack of correlation.

claim: The var DBLα dataset shows higher D values than the microsatellite dataset.
source_text: The D values of the var DBLα dataset are higher than those of the microsatellite dataset (pv<<0.0001 by Mann–Whitney test)
evidence_reasoning: This is based on statistical comparison of linkage disequilibrium coefficients between the two datasets.

claim: Both var DBLα and microsatellite datasets show an enrichment of positive correlations among allele pairs, indicating significant linkage disequilibrium.
source_text: Therefore, both datasets show an enrichment of positive correlations among allele pairs, and thus, significant linkage disequilibrium.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on statistical analysis comparing observed to expected numbers of significant correlations.

claim: The higher D values for var DBLα alleles versus microsatellite alleles cannot be attributed to differences in allele frequencies.
source_text: The higher D values for var DBLα alleles versus microsatellite alleles cannot be attributed to differences in allele frequencies since the var DBLα alleles have lower frequencies than the microsatellite alleles, and thus, D values biased to lower magnitudes.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on analysis of allele frequencies and understanding of how D is affected by frequency.

claim: The model constrains total repertoire diversity to levels that are orders of magnitude lower than is potentially possible given the diversity of the gene pool.
source_text: In accordance with predictions from the original 'strain theory', our model constrains total repertoire diversity to levels that are orders of magnitude lower than is potentially possible given the diversity of the gene pool.
evidence_reasoning: This is a summary finding from the model simulations.

claim: Coexisting parasites are structured into a few variants with largely discordant repertoires.
source_text: This reduction in diversity occurs because coexisting parasites are structured into a few variants with largely discordant repertoires.
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the model simulations.

claim: Different dominant repertoires can exhibit partial overlap, with the extent of overlap increasing with transmission intensity.
source_text: In a departure from previous strain theory, our model predicts that the different dominant repertoires can exhibit partial overlap; the extent of the overlap increases with transmission intensity
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the model simulations shown in Figures 2 and 3.

claim: The specific immune profile of each individual host structures the population into distinct sets of patches or resources that define an immune environment, causing immune selection to act on the parasite population.
source_text: The specific immune profile of each individual host effectively structures the population into distinct sets of 'patches' or 'resources' that define an immune environment, ultimately causing immune selection to act on the parasite population.
evidence_reasoning: This is an interpretation of the mechanism by which the model produces structured populations.

claim: Distinct sets of patches are formed and conserved even when immunity to var alleles is shorter-lived.
source_text: These distinct sets of patches are formed and conserved even when immunity to the var alleles is shorter-lived.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on additional model simulations testing the effect of immunity duration.

claim: Vector control efforts that reduce antigenic overlap between strains will result in infection at an older age and more gradual acquisition of protection to infection.
source_text: By reducing antigenic overlap between strains, vector control efforts will result in infection at an older age and a more gradual acquisition of protection to infection, even in the absence of changes in var gene diversity.
evidence_reasoning: This is a prediction based on the model's findings about the relationship between transmission intensity and antigenic overlap.

claim: More severe symptoms are expected to occur at younger ages under high transmission settings.
source_text: if the number of var genes that a host has previously encountered relates to the degree of protection against clinical disease, we would expect more severe symptoms to occur at younger ages under high transmission settings
evidence_reasoning: This is a speculative prediction based on the model's findings, conditional on an assumption about the relationship between var exposure and disease severity.

claim: More homogeneous malaria incidents are likely to occur over a broader range of age-classes when transmission is lowered.
source_text: in contrast, more homogeneous malaria incidents are likely to occur over a broader range of age-classes when transmission is lowered
evidence_reasoning: This is a speculative prediction based on the model's findings about age-structured immunity patterns.

claim: Chen et al. (2011) demonstrated the existence of an immense diversity of var genes and limited var repertoire overlap in Africa, even in sites with low malaria prevalence.
source_text: Chen et al. (2011) have pointed to the importance of var genes in malaria surveillance, due to their influence on both the duration of infection and the degree of superinfection, and they demonstrated the existence of an immense diversity of var genes and limited var repertoire overlap in Africa, even in sites with low malaria prevalence.
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from a cited study by Chen et al., 2011.

claim: Decreasing transmission provokes nonlinear changes in the dominant var configurations.
source_text: Our models support this proposal as they show that decreasing transmission provokes nonlinear changes in the dominant var configurations.
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the model simulations.

claim: Vector control strategies that reduce transmission will not always drastically reduce var gene diversity because a reservoir of parasite genomes with diverse, highly non-overlapping var repertoires will remain.
source_text: Indeed, the 'var strain' model suggests that vector control strategies that reduce transmission will not always drastically reduce var gene diversity, because a reservoir of parasite genomes with diverse (highly non-overlapping) var repertoires will remain.
evidence_reasoning: This is an inference from the model's findings about the relationship between transmission intensity and repertoire structure.

claim: Non-overlapping var diversity creates significant inherent difficulties in reducing the potential of the malaria parasite to reinfect the same hosts.
source_text: This insight from the model provides a plausible explanation for why it is so difficult to eliminate malaria: non-overlapping var diversity will create significant inherent difficulties in reducing the potential of the malaria parasite to reinfect the same hosts.
evidence_reasoning: This is an inference about the implications of the model's findings for malaria elimination efforts.

claim: Var surveillance might provide a good molecular means of evaluating malaria control.
source_text: It also suggests that var surveillance might provide a good molecular means of evaluating control.
evidence_reasoning: This is a recommendation based on the model's findings about how var diversity changes with transmission intensity.

claim: The results have broad implications for the possible emergence of similar structure in many important human and animal pathogens that have major surface antigens encoded by multigene families.
source_text: In conclusion, the results of our model on the dynamics of population structure in P. falciparum as defined by the var multi-gene family, have broad implications for the possible emergence of similar structure in many important human and animal pathogens that have major surface antigens encoded by multigene families, including bacterial, protozoan and fungal pathogens
evidence_reasoning: This is an inference about the broader applicability of the model's findings to other pathogen systems.

claim: Each parasite is composed of exactly g var genes in the model.
source_text: Each parasite is composed of a set of exactly g var genes
evidence_reasoning: This is a specification of the model structure.

claim: The overall diversity of var genes circulating in the host population originates from a general predefined pool of G variants.
source_text: The overall diversity of var genes circulating in the host population is assumed to originate from a general predefined pool of G variants
evidence_reasoning: This is a specification of the model structure.

claim: The total number of distinct var repertoires is G!/(G-g)!.
source_text: Hence, the total number of distinct var repertoires is G!/(G-g)!.
evidence_reasoning: This is a mathematical calculation based on the combinatorics of sampling g genes from a pool of G.

claim: After the host is exposed to each VSA, it gains life-long immunity that is specific to each of the antigens.
source_text: After the host is exposed to each of these VSAs, it gains life-long immunity that is specific to each of the antigens
evidence_reasoning: This is an assumption of the model based on cited literature about immunity to var antigens.

claim: The total duration of infection in a susceptible host lasts a fixed time (κyrs.).
source_text: We assume that the total duration of infection in a susceptible host lasts a fixed time (κyrs.)
evidence_reasoning: This is a specification of the model structure.

claim: In partially immune hosts, the actual duration of infection decreases proportionally to the number of var genes that have been expressed in earlier infections.
source_text: and that in partially immune hosts, the actual duration decreases proportionally to the number of var genes that have been expressed in earlier infections
evidence_reasoning: This is an assumption of the model based on cited literature about immunity effects on infection duration.

claim: Var genes composing an infecting parasite are mutually and exclusively expressed in a fixed sequential order.
source_text: we capture this feature by considering that the var genes composing an infecting parasite are mutually and exclusively expressed in a fixed sequential order
evidence_reasoning: This is a specification of the model structure.

claim: An infected host can harbor multiple simultaneously co-infecting parasite genomes.
source_text: An infected host can harbor multiple simultaneously co-infecting parasite genomes
evidence_reasoning: This is a specification of the model structure.

claim: When a biting event takes place, each infecting parasite has a probability of being transmitted that depends on transmission probability and the number of co-infecting parasite genomes.
source_text: When such an event takes place, each of the infecting parasites has a probability, of being transmitted that depends on transmission probability and the number of co-infecting parasite genomes
evidence_reasoning: This is a specification of the model structure describing transmission dynamics.

claim: DBLα is the only domain found in nearly all PfEMP1 variants, making the sequence encoding the central portion of this domain the most informative molecular marker of var gene diversity.
source_text: Because DBLα is the only domain found in nearly all PfEMP1 variants (Miller et al., 2002), the sequence encoding the central portion of this domain provides the most informative molecular marker of var gene diversity
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about var gene structure and its implications for molecular markers.

claim: Two DBLα tags are considered to represent two distinct var 'types' if their nucleotide sequence identity is less than 96%.
source_text: Two DBLα tags are considered to represent two distinct var 'types' if their nucleotide sequence identity is less than 96%.
evidence_reasoning: This is a methodological specification for defining distinct var types in the empirical analysis.

claim: Microsatellites offer an ideal and practical means to construct a null hypothesis reflecting demographic forces shaping diversity because these sites are predominantly neutral.
source_text: Microsatellites offer an ideal and practical means to construct a null hypothesis reflecting the demographic forces shaping diversity because these sites are predominantly neutral, and their diversity can be explained by a mechanism unrelated to immune selection (i.e., slippage).
evidence_reasoning: This is based on established knowledge about the neutral nature of microsatellite variation.

claim: D is maximized when allele frequencies are 0.5.
source_text: D is maximized when allele frequencies are 0.5
evidence_reasoning: This is established knowledge about the properties of the linkage disequilibrium coefficient D.

claim: The great majority of var loci are located very far from other var loci in the 3D7 genome.
source_text: it seems somewhat unlikely because the great majority of var loci are located very far from other var loci in the 3D7 genome
evidence_reasoning: This is based on cited knowledge about var gene genomic organization from Deitsch and Hviid, 2004.

claim: Var loci have been shown to coincide with recombination hotspots.
source_text: var loci have been shown to coincide with recombination hotspots
evidence_reasoning: This is based on cited studies by Mu et al., 2010 and Jiang et al., 2011.

claim: The P. falciparum genome is characterized by remarkably high underlying rates of recombination.
source_text: in a genome that is already characterized by remarkably high underlying rates of recombination
evidence_reasoning: This is based on cited studies by Conway et al., 1999 and Volkman et al., 2006.
